title: Fate Chess Piece
next_chapter_hook: The voice was ice-cold and biting, carrying an imperious mockery—"You think you're a chess player? How laughable. You've always been just a discarded piece on my chessboard."

text.content: The moment the golden figure stepped into the ruins, Chen Ji felt a suffocating pressure surge toward him like a tide. The surrounding air seemed to solidify into substance, and every wisp of spiritual energy trembled under the gaze of that supreme will. The Fate Chess Piece in his hand suddenly burned scalding hot, as if wanting to incinerate his entire being. The Tianqing Sect disciples all knelt prostrate, yet he alone stood like a solitary pine in the center of the storm.

"Chen Ji, the servant disciple?" That cold voice carried no emotion whatsoever, yet it resonated throughout the entire ruins, "Hand over that thing on you." Ling Yuan's aged face flickered in the golden light, his lips bearing a barely perceptible cold smile. Chen Ji felt the Tianji Record Fragment in his embrace suddenly leap, producing some mysterious resonance with the Fate Chess Piece in his palm—a frequency he had never felt before.

dialogue.content: "Old me shows mercy for your cultivated不容易, giving you one chance." Ling Yuan stepped forward, golden light blooming like lotus flowers beneath his feet, "If you willingly offer up the Tianji Fragment, old me can promise you a splendid future." His gaze swept over Chen Ji, that look clearly viewing him as an ant.

text.content: Chen Jisneered in his heart. Splendid future? In his previous life, he had believed such nonsense and ended up with his body destroyed and path severed. The Fate Chess Piece wildly trembled in his palm, the characters on the Tianji Record Fragment began flowing on their own, and countless obscure runes moved like living things. A hoarse voice suddenly rang in his mind—that was the remnant soul of Master Mo Xiansheng.

dialogue.content: "Boy, the time has come." Master Mo Xiansheng's voice was weak yet urgent, "When the Fate Chess Piece resonates with the Tianji Record, that is the moment the Tianji Diagram manifests. If you retreat now, there will be no chance for a comeback!"

text.content: Ling Yuan's brow furrowed slightly. He sensed that Chen Ji's aura was undergoing some subtle change—that waste actually had such pure Heavenly Secrets power within him? Impossible! He had personally witnessed Chen Xuan passing down the Tianji Record back then, clearly skipping over himself and choosing another. Could it be that...

At the moment Ling Yuan was distracted, Chen Ji forcefully activated his Heavenly Fate Value. 5 points, 10 points, 15 points—he madly burned his luck, only to exchange for that moment of clarity. The Fate Chess Piece exploded in his palm, turning into countless starlight that enveloped him. A vast and boundless diagram slowly unfolded in the void—that was—the complete Tianji Diagram!

The entire ruins came to a complete standstill at that moment. Ling Yuan's pupils contracted sharply. What did he see? On that diagram, densely packed light points formed a massive net covering the entire continent. Every light point was a person, some dazzlingly brilliant, some dim and about to extinguish. And at the very center of the chessboard, one light point was flashing frantically—that radiance was actually more dazzling than anyone else!

choice.prompt: At the moment the Tianji Diagram manifested, Chen Ji saw his position in the game of fate—he was both a pawn being controlled and possessed the possibility to break the chessboard. Faced with Ling Yuan's coercion, he must make a choice:

choices.description: Continue playing the useless person act, retreat to advance, make Ling Yuan relax his guard, secretly seek a way to break the situation
choices.visible_cost: Withstand Ling Yuan's pressure, consume 15 Heavenly Fate Value points
choices.visible_reward: Hide true strength, plant the seed of contempt in Ling Yuan's heart
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan might see through the disguise

text.content: Chen Ji thudded to his knees, body trembling, voice carrying just the right amount of fear: "Senior, spare my life! This junior didn't know such a treasure was on me! I'm willing to offer this treasure to beg for the senior's mercy!" His acting was superb, even squeezing out a few tears. Ling Yuan coldly snorted: "You know what's good for you." Yet the palm he extended showed absolutely no sign of retreating—his killing intent had already been activated.

Chen Ji laughed coldly in his heart. Killing intent? He had seen it clearly in the Tianji Diagram long ago. Every step Ling Yuan took was being pushed by another invisible hand. And the owner of that hand—Chen Ji cast his gaze toward a certain point in the void—was watching this good show with great interest.

choices.text: Burn the boats and draw the sword
choices.description: No longer hide, use the Tianji Diagram as proof, publicly expose Ling Yuan's wolf-like ambitions, let everyone present see the truth
choices.visible_cost: Expose the complete abilities of the Tianji Record, consume 30 Heavenly Fate Value points, may attract the covetous attention of stronger cultivators
choices.visible_reward: Publicly humiliate Ling Yuan, gain the re-examination of disciples present
choices.risk_hint: Completely offend Ling Yuan, lose the advantage of concealment

text.content: "Ling Yuan." Chen Ji slowly stood up, brushed the dust off his knees, a faint and indifferent arc curving his lips, "Do you truly think you're executing heavenly justice?" His voice was not loud, yet it clearly spread throughout the entire ruins, "You're merely a chess piece being used. What's the benefit for you in fighting me?"

dialogue.content: "Insolent!" Ling Yuan laughed in extreme anger, a trace of ferocity flashing across his aged face, "A waste dares to lecture this old man? Today, this old man will let you know what it means to have the heavens above and earth below!" He raised his hand to suppress him.

choices.text: Risk life and activate the full power of the Fate Chess Piece
choices.description: Burn all Heavenly Fate Value, trigger the ultimate form of the Fate Chess Piece, let the Tianji Diagram reveal the true chess game—the layout of the Eye of Heavenly Fate
choices.visible_cost: Consume all Heavenly Fate Value, may fall into unconsciousness
choices.visible_reward: Reveal the truth behind Ling Yuan to everyone, redirect the spear toward the true幕后黑手
choices.risk_hint: The price is extremely high, consequences are unpredictable

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, fully activating the resonance between the Tianji Record Fragment and the Fate Chess Piece. 50 points of Heavenly Fate Value poured out like a breached dam, transforming into brilliant golden light that illuminated the entire ruins as bright as day. The Tianji Diagram frantically expanded, countless hidden threads converging from all directions—and those threads' destinations all pointed in the same direction.

On the Tianji Diagram, countless scenes flashed like a carousel. Chen Ji saw himself—no, countless "selves." Every incarnation of Chen Ji had obtained the Tianji Record, yet each was "chosen" at different moments and perished in various ways. Past life, present life, future... all timelines intertwined at this moment into a massive net.

"Do you see it now?" Master Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind, carrying uncontrollable excitement, "The Tianji Record was never an inheritance treasure, it's a key—a key to open the Heavenly Fate Chess Game! And you, Chen Ji, are the chosen one among the prophetic ones through the ages. But your choice will determine whether you become a chess piece or break the chessboard!"

Ling Yuan's expression changed drastically. He saw it too—in the depths of the Tianji Diagram, there was a vague yet terrifyingly powerful existence gazing at all this. Those invisible eyes crossed time and space, as if standing right behind Chen Ji. A flash of terror crossed Ling Yuan's pupils—he remembered Chen Xuan's curse before death: "You will never obtain the Tianji Record, because the one it chooses... was never you."

dialogue.content: Just then, an ice-cold voice rang out from the Fate Chess Piece, shaking the souls of everyone present: "Interesting... this generation's prophetic one is somewhat smarter than those before." That voice carried not a shred of emotion, yet it froze Ling Yuan instantly where he stood, not daring to act rashly—for that was a force surpassing the mundane, the will of Heavenly Fate itself!

text.content: Chen Ji felt an intense chill spread from the soles of his feet to his entire body. The Eye of Heavenly Fate—that legendary ultimate existence, that terrifying will that had used generations of prophetic ones as chess pieces, actually existed! He should have known. Every prophecy from the Tianji Record Fragment consumed Heavenly Fate Value, and Heavenly Fate Value... was originally a gift from Heavenly Fate, a debt!

choice.prompt: The Eye of Heavenly Fate's voice echoed in the void. Ling Yuan knelt to the ground, not daring to raise his head, yet Chen Ji felt an unprecedented fury burning in his chest. Faced with this terrifying existence that had manipulated everything, he must make a choice:

choices.text: Question the Eye of Heavenly Fate
choices.description: Since the other party has already revealed itself, why not directly confront and ask clearly about all the reasons and his fate
choices.visible_cost: May be erased or punished by the Eye of Heavenly Fate
choices.visible_reward: Obtain crucial information, accumulate capital for future resistance
choices.risk_hint: The opponent is too powerful, questioning may bring disaster

text.content: "Since you chose me, why must you manipulate my fate?" Chen Ji's voice trembled, yet carried unyielding sharpness, "The prophetic ones through the ages... their deaths, were all your doing?" He spoke word by word, transforming his long-suppressed fury into a question. The Fate Chess Piece hummed in his palm, as if responding to his will.

dialogue.content: "An interesting question." That cold voice carried a hint of amusement, "But have you considered—if I hadn't chosen you, you wouldn't even have the qualification to stand here and question." Before the words even finished, an invisible force suddenly pressed down on Chen Ji, driving his entire body three feet into the ground!

choices.text: Seize the momentum to counterattack Ling Yuan
choices.description: The Eye of Heavenly Fate revealing itself is an excellent opportunity to suppress Ling Yuan, publicly expose his connection to the Eye of Heavenly Fate
choices.visible_cost: Completely offend both the Eye of Heavenly Fate and Ling Yuan
choices.visible_reward: Publicly humiliate Ling Yuan, prove he's not someone to be pushed around
choices.risk_hint: Offend two major forces simultaneously, consequences unpredictable

text.content: Chen Ji wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth, slowly climbing out from underground. His gaze越过 the Eye of Heavenly Fate's oppression, directly at Ling Yuan kneeling on the ground, his voice cold and clear as ice: "Sect Master Ling Yuan, you just said this thing doesn't belong to me? Now that the Eye of Heavenly Fate has personally appeared, why don't you ask him, who does this Tianji Record... belong to?"

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan's face turned ashen, veins bulging on his forehead, yet he couldn't utter a single word. He didn't dare raise his head, nor dare defend himself. Chen Ji coldly laughed: "Why aren't you speaking? Where's that face of heavenly justice from just now?" At this moment, all the resentment he'd suppressed over the years as atrash erupted completely, making everyone present see a completely different Chen Ji.

choices.description: Pretend to have seen nothing, heard nothing, continue playing thetrash, wait for a better opportunity
choices.visible_cost: Abandon this chance to expose the truth
choices.risk_hint: May be seen through by the Eye of Heavenly Fate

text.content: Chen Ji thudded to his knees once more, body shaking like a sieve, eyes full of terror: "Senior, spare my life! This junior saw nothing, heard nothing! This junior is just a servant disciple, I beg the Heavenly Fate Lord to spare this junior!" His performance was impeccable, even Master Mo Xiansheng praising in his Mental Sea: "Good boy, this acting, even I would believe it."

That ice-cold voice fell silent for a moment, then let out a meaningful chuckle: "Somewhat interesting." Then, that pressure that had shrouded heaven and earth suddenly dissipated, as if it had never existed. Ling Yuan knelt呆呆 on the ground, gazing at the empty void, unable to回过神来 for a long time. He didn't understand why the Eye of Heavenly Fate would spare Chen Ji, but he knew—the matter was far from simple.

The instant the Eye of Heavenly Fate dissipated, the entire ruins fell into deathly silence. Ling Yuan slowly stood up, his turbid old eyes flickering with complex light. He glanced at Chen Ji, his gaze containing both wariness and contemplation—thistrash's secrets ran much deeper than he had imagined.

"Chen Ji." Ling Yuan's voice was hoarse and low, "Today's matter, this old man will remember." He said nothing more, turned, and transformed into a stream of light disappearing into the depths of the ruins. But in the moment before leaving, Chen Ji saw Ling Yuan's lips curve into a meaningful smile—that smile set off alarm bells in his heart. This scheming old sect master would never let this matter rest.

The Tianqing Sect disciples in the ruins exchanged bewildered glances. That scene just now had completely exceeded their comprehension. Tianji Record? Eye of Heavenly Fate? Sect Master Ling Yuan's embarrassing state? Where was this something they ordinary disciples could understand? Someone secretly glanced at Chen Ji, only to find thattrash leaning against the wall, a harmless silly smile on his face, as if none of what had happened concerned him.

Chen Ji closed his eyes, his consciousness sinking into his Mental Sea. Master Mo Xiansheng's figure emerged from the fragment, his aged face carrying unprecedented gravity: "Boy, what you saw today is merely the tip of the iceberg. The Eye of Heavenly Fate's layout spans tens of millions of years, you're merely one piece in it. But this master must tell you one thing—the退婚 matter was not orchestrated by Ling Yuan. The true幕后黑手 only revealed its first clues today."

dialogue.content: "Master's meaning is..." Chen Ji's heart stirred, "The Su family's退婚 back then had other secrets?" Master Mo Xiansheng nodded: "That marriage was a chess move laid by the previous prophetic one, and the退婚... was someone trying to sever your destined bond with someone. Who wanted to do this, and why—these are the directions you'll need to investigate in the future."

text.content: Chen Ji thought of Su Qingyao—that Inner Disciple Senior Fellow who repeatedly approached the truth. That family lady who had an engagement with him yet rescinded it. If退婚 was to sever bonds, whose bonds were being severed? The Su family? Or someone else? He suddenly remembered a scene that had flashed across the Tianji Diagram—a vague feminine figure connected to him by countless threads, yet whose face he couldn't see no matter how hard he tried.

Right then, a trace of warmth remaining in his palm from the Fate Chess Piece suddenly transformed into a line of burning golden text—that was the Eye of Heavenly Fate's voice, directly carved into his divine soul across the void: "You think you're a chess player? How laughable." Chen Ji froze all over, those words branding his consciousness like a searing mark. He raised his head, his gaze穿透 the ruins' dome, as if seeing those supreme eyes that gazed across time and space at him.

Chen Ji took a deep breath, slowly standing up. He raised his head toward that emptiness, a faint arc curving his lips—that was stubbornness only he himself could see. So what if I'm a chess piece? So what if I'm being manipulated? In my past life, I didn't know the truth, could only be at others' mercy; but in this life, since I've already seen the chessboard, I will overturn this game! Eye of Heavenly Fate, since you chose me, don't blame me for turning your chess game upside down!
